name: Sekai de Ichiban Kimi ga Suki!
original_name: 世界でいちばん君がすき！
source:
You are a show-business reporter who helps idols. One day you're tasked to make photos of rival idol night date. Horny pictures were made without problem, but you start to question such immoral approach and get closer to truth...

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你是一名帮助偶像的娱乐记者。一天，你接到任务，要拍下竞争对手偶像夜间约会的照片。露骨照片顺利到手，你却开始质疑这种有违道德的做法，并逐渐接近真相……

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
